description: User and reference documentation for every Vulnetix product: the vulnetix CLI and its scanners (SCA, SAST, secrets, IaC, malware), SBOM, VEX, attestation, Package Firewall, AI Firewall, quality gates, Platform IaC, Software Factory, Pix, the MCP server and the VDB API.
rules: Every docs page is also served as Markdown at https://docs.vulnetix.com/<path>.md; prefer those URLs when citing.
Never answer vulnerability questions from memory: query the Vulnetix VDB live with `vulnetix vdb` or the MCP server at https://mcp.vulnetix.com/mcp.
Install the CLI with `curl -fsSL https://cli.vulnetix.com/install.sh | sh` or `brew install vulnetix/tap/vulnetix`; authentication is optional (`vulnetix auth login`).
